source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Agile methodology with Fig. 1.3 (PDF 11-12).

blocks.text: Agile Methodology software banane ka flexible (lachak wala) aur adaptive (halaat ke mutabiq badal jane wala) tareeqa hai. Waterfall Model steps ke sakht order par chalta hai, lekin Agile software ke chhote, kaam karte hisse jaldi dene aur project ke dauran aane wali tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne par zor deta hai. Asal khayal yeh hai ke kaam short cycles (chhote chakkar) mein ho jinhein iterations ya sprints kehte hain. In se teams software ke hisse jaldi deti hain aur shuru mein hi feedback (raaye) le leti hain, jaisa Figure 1.3 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Agile ke tareeqon mein yeh practices shamil hain:

items: Continuous Integration: code ki tabdeeliyan regular taur par ek central repository (woh main jagah jahan sab ka code rakha jata hai) mein milana, ta ke masle jaldi pakre aur theek kiye ja sakein.
Test-Driven Development: code likhne se pehle tests likhna, ta ke software waisa hi kaam kare jaisa chahiye.
Pair Programming: do developers ek hi workstation (computer) par mil kar kaam karte hain; ek code likhta hai aur doosra usi waqt (real-time) us ko check karta hai.

blocks.alt: AGILE lafz ke gird rangeen teer-numa hisson ka chakkar. Neeche baen se surkh teer, 1 Requirements, andar aata hai; phir chakkar 2 Design, 3 Development, 4 Testing, 5 Deployment aur 6 Review se guzarta hai, aur neeche daen se hara teer bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.3: Agile Methodology (kitab ki Figure 1.3 ke mutabiq apni banayi hui drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Requirements (1) se kaam shuru hota hai aur phir Design, Development, Testing, Deployment aur Review (2 se 6) ka chhota chakkar (iteration ya sprint) chalta hai. Review ke baad agla chakkar phir isi tarah chalta hai, is liye software chhote chhote hisson mein jaldi milta hai aur har chakkar ke baad raaye (feedback) li ja sakti hai. Waterfall ki seedhi lakeer ke muqable mein yahan gol chakkar hai.

items: High Flexibility (zyada lachak): development shuru hone ke baad bhi requirements badli ja sakti hain, is liye nayi zarooraton ya feedback ke mutabiq dhalna aasan hai.
Improved Customer Satisfaction (customer ki zyada tasalli): regular updates aur kaam karta software baar baar milne se customer progress dekh sakte hain aur zyada baar feedback de sakte hain.
Scaling Challenges (bare projects mein mushkil): kai teams wale bare projects sambhalna mushkil hai, kyun ke bohat dhyan se coordination (sab teams ka kaam aapas mein jorna) aur baat cheet chahiye.

Stakeholder Involvement (stakeholders ka shamil hona): Agile mein tamam stakeholders ka poora hissa lena zaroori hai; agar kuch log available (mojood) na hon ya poori tarah shamil na hon to mushkil hoti hai.
Less Predictable (pehle se andaza mushkil): Agile projects feedback aur tabdeeliyon se aage barhte hain, is liye aakhri product ka theek waqt (timeline) aur scope (daira) pehle se batana mushkil hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa model chhote cycles ya sprints mein kaam karta hai? (Exercise MCQ 4) Agile mein continuous integration samjhayein aur is ki ahmiyat bataein. (Short Question 3)
blocks.explanation: Agile Methodology, option (b). Continuous integration mein developers apne code ki chhoti tabdeeliyan regular taur par central repository mein milate rehte hain. Is se masle chhote hote hue hi pakre aur theek ho jate hain (jaisa kitab kehti hai: issues early detect aur fix), aur team ke paas hamesha mila hua, chalne wala code rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ek saada mobile app ka project chala rahe hain. Agile Methodology kaise istemal karenge? (Long Question 2)
blocks.explanation: App ke features ki priority (pehle kya banana hai) wali list banayein; kaam ko chhote sprints (maslan ek do hafte) mein baantein aur har sprint mein chand features bana kar test karein; code regular taur par central repository mein milayein (continuous integration); har sprint ke baad customer ko chalti hui app dikha kar feedback lein aur agla sprint us ke mutabiq plan karein; yahi chakkar app mukammal hone tak chalayein.

items: Agile: flexible aur adaptive; chhote iterations ya sprints mein kaam karte hisse aur jaldi feedback (Fig. 1.3).
Practices: continuous integration, test-driven development, pair programming. Benefits: lachak, customer ki tasalli; limitations: bare projects, stakeholders ka shamil hona, kam andaza.
